brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball news thumbnail as a PNG, landscape 1536 x 864 (16:9).

Editorial content is based ONLY on the supplied fixed article dated 2026-11-07: it covers game results and the day's official EFF top three by league and registered position. It is not a season-average ranking or a prediction. Do not invent scores, results, player statistics, or claims about the depicted player's performance.

Art direction: match the approved バスケまとめ black-and-lime v3 aesthetic: nearly black #151A18 ground, electric lime #CCF43B dry-brush strokes, creamy white heavyweight Japanese typography, bold hand-drawn ink contours, expressive brush hatching and restrained paper texture. Strong clear shapes and very few elements. Clearly an illustration, never photorealistic, never a photo collage.

Person: depict exactly ONE real basketball player, Seiya Konishi / 小西聖也, as a recognizable ink illustration. He was randomly chosen from the 36 unique players in the fixed article's daily EFF tables, not selected as the article's star. Official appearance references were visually checked at https://www.bleague.jp/roster_detail/?PlayerID=51000117 and its portrait https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/744/2026-27/51000117_03.png, plus the official club portrait at https://broncos20.jp/news/detail/id=60113.
Observed features to preserve: young adult Japanese man, athletic lean guard build; short, thick dark hair with a loose near-center part and slightly wavy lifted strands, short clean sides; clean-shaven; elongated oval face, smooth cheeks and a moderately tapered rounded chin; prominent ears; dark straight brows; alert almond-shaped dark eyes, medium straight nose with a gently rounded tip, medium lips. Keep his face readable in a three-quarter view, with his real youthful face proportions, not a generic muscular invented athlete.

Composition: player on the LEFT half in a dynamic low, forward drive, torso leaning diagonally toward center, knees bent, one hand clearly contacting the top/side of a single orange basketball during a controlled dribble, opposite arm naturally extended for balance. Show head, both shoulders, hands, and enough legs to make the action clear. Ball and both hands fully inside the canvas; natural fingers and joints, exactly two arms. A sharp lime brush arc suggests momentum behind him. No second person, no crowd, no court furniture. His uniform is plain unbranded charcoal with cream highlights: no logo, no sponsor, no name, no number, no recognizable team mark. Draw the entire scene from scratch in ink; do not embed official photos. This is a conceptual basketball movement illustration, not a reconstruction of an actual game.

RIGHT half: generous clean dark negative space for three stacked typographic lines. Japanese text must be reproduced EXACTLY, bold, large, highly legible on a mobile thumbnail. Keep every glyph inside generous safe margins and separate text clearly from the body, ball and brush art.
Top small brand text: 「バスケまとめ」
Top small date: 「2026.11.07」
Main headline, large white: 「試合結果」
Second line, large lime: 「当日EFF」
Third line, moderately large white: 「ポジション別TOP3」
Bottom footer in clear cream type, legible and uncropped: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」.

Render only those exact six text entries plus the date. Do not render the person's name, team, jersey number, performance, participation claims or scores. Do not use the wording 成績をもとにしたイメージ. No team logos, league logos, watermarks, English slogans, extra badges or decorative random text. Keep restrained editorial energy and a premium clean hierarchy.
